question: Let $\vec{a}=2\hat{i}-\hat{j}+2\hat{k}$ and $\vec{b}=-\hat{i}+2\hat{j}+2\hat{k}$. Define $\vec{r}=\vec{a}+2\vec{b}$.(a) Determine $\vec{r}$ and its magnitude.(b) Find a unit vector in the direction of $\vec{r}$.(c) Obtain a vector of magnitude $10$ directed opposite to $\vec{r}$ and verify its magnitude.
explanation: (a)First,`2\vec{b}=-2\hat{i}+4\hat{j}+4\hat{k}`Therefore,`\vec{r}=\vec{a}+2\vec{b}\vec{r}=(2-2)\hat{i}+(-1+4)\hat{j}+(2+4)\hat{k}\vec{r}=3\hat{j}+6\hat{k}`Its magnitude is`|\vec{r}|=\sqrt{3^2+6^2}=3\sqrt{5}`(b)The unit vector in the direction of $\vec{r}$ is`\hat{r}=\frac{\vec{r}}{|\vec{r}|}=\frac{3\hat{j}+6\hat{k}}{3\sqrt{5}}\hat{r}=\frac{1}{\sqrt{5}}\hat{j}+\frac{2}{\sqrt{5}}\hat{k}`(c)The unit vector opposite to $\vec{r}$ is $-\hat{r}$. Therefore, the required vector is`\vec{p}=-10\hat{r}=-2\sqrt{5}\hat{j}-4\sqrt{5}\hat{k}`Its magnitude is`|\vec{p}|=\sqrt{(-2\sqrt{5})^2+(-4\sqrt{5})^2}|\vec{p}|=\sqrt{20+80}=10`Final ResultThe required vector is $-2\sqrt{5}\hat{j}-4\sqrt{5}\hat{k}$, and its magnitude is $10$.
